items: capture-render-quality-v1 items 2+3: DN-Splatter-style depth/normal losses + Depth Anything V2 Small prior
status: code+tests landed (default OFF: ReconstructionConfig.depth_prior='none'); no GPU spent

licence.model: depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf @ 5426e4f0f36572d16453bbda7a8389317b1bef99 (Apache-2.0, verified on the Hub card 2026-10-06)
licence.refused: Base/Large/Giant (CC-BY-NC-4.0) raise LicenseError in depth_prior_cache.model_repo and are not valid config values (AUTH #049, method-only)
licence.losses: DN-Splatter method only, re-implemented in dn_torch.py (torch mirrors of depth_normal.py / depth_prior.py with parity tests); no DN-Splatter code or weights vendored. No monocular-normal network: prior normals are derived from the aligned prior depth.

wiring.trainer: render_quality.depth_normal_own_args -> ns_train_capped --depth-prior-dir (+ --sensor-depth-dir when an ARKit depth cache exists); errors if the prior is configured but missing
wiring.losses: ns_train_capped.install_depth_normal (from step 500): pearson(rendered inverse depth, prior disparity) x0.2; normal_consistency(rendered-depth normals, aligned-prior normals) x0.1; edge-aware log-L1 vs ARKit depth x0.2 when present; normal TV x0.05; alpha > 0.5 mask
wiring.modal: retrain_clip(depth_prior=...) builds the cache in-container then trains; image gains a cached 'depth-prior' layer (weights baked, no Hub at run time)

cost_estimate_usd.image_layer_build: ~0.05 (CPU pip + 100 MB weight download, one time)
cost_estimate_usd.prior_inference_per_room: ~0.05 (ViT-S, ~300 frames, <1 min on L40S inside the training container)

cost_estimate_usd.ab_new_arm_only_reusing_item1_baseline: ~2.6 (4 runs: winner-config + depth_prior on the 4 corpus rooms; baseline = item-1 winner arm already on the volume)
cost_estimate_usd.bedroom_arm: ~0.55 (owner-room-01, #046 private; metrics only in the repo)
